title: RoaringBitmap unions subtype arrays
summary: Heap and buffer aggregation both threw ArrayStoreException on subtype arrays before the fix. Both fixed paths returned the 16-member union and preserved every input reference and element after permutation.

change.description: Upstream reports `ArrayStoreException` before. After, both calls return the integers 0 through 12 inclusive, then 100000, 200000 and 300000, in order.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.

Heap and buffer aggregation both threw ArrayStoreException on subtype arrays before the fix. Both fixed paths returned the 16-member union and preserved every input reference and element after permutation.
